sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in connection with Madhuban P.S. Case No. 337 of 2022 registered for the offence under Sections 376(D) of the Indian Penal Code, Section 4/6 of the POCSO Act, and Section 67 of the I.T. Act.
3. As per the prosecution case, all the accused persons have committed rape with the victim.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and has not committed any offence.

He further submits that co-accused Umesh Prasad who is the main accused has Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.66614 of 2024(2)
dt.05-10-2024 been granted bail by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 12.09.2023 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 45600 of 2023.
5. Learned A.P.P. has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.
